title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Step Functions
description: Create an EventBridge rule that triggers a Step Functions workflow

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates running a Step Functions workflow using an EventBridge rule. The template creates a shell Step Functions workflow with a CloudWatch log group for error reporting. It is triggered on select EC2 instance state changes and branches based on the value.
